AND M.ReciptDate >= #{start} AND M.ReciptDate < ADDDATE(#{end}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

mapper.sql: M.MantncNo, M.MenuName, M.ReciptId, M.ReciptName, M.ReciptTitle, CAST(M.ReciptDate AS CHAR) AS ReciptDate, M.ExecState, DATE_FORMAT(M.ExecExpectDate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS ExecExpectDate, M.ExecCntnts, CAST(M.ExecDate AS CHAR) AS ExecDate, M.ExecId, M.ExecName, M.CmpletCntnts, CAST(M.CmpletDate AS CHAR) AS CmpletDate, M.CmpletId, M.CmpletName, AS Overdue
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM shopwizard.tOprMantnc M
ORDER BY (M.ExecState = 'cmplet'), M.MantncNo DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(M.ExecState = 'recipt'), 0) AS recipt, IFNULL(SUM(M.ExecState = 'exec'), 0) AS exec, IFNULL(SUM(M.ExecState = 'cmplet'), 0) AS cmplet, IFNULL(SUM(), 0) AS overdue FROM shopwizard.tOprMantnc M AND M.ReciptId = #{ownerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tOprMantnc SET ReciptTitle = #{title}, ReciptCntnts = #{content}, MenuName = #{menuName}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE MantncNo = #{mantncNo} AND ExecState <> 'cmplet'

UPDATE shopwizard.tOprMantnc SET ExecDate = IF(ExecState = 'recipt', NOW(), ExecDate), ExecId = IF(ExecState = 'recipt', #{execId}, ExecId), ExecName = IF(ExecState = 'recipt', #{execName}, ExecName), ExecExpectDate = #{expectDate}, ExecCntnts = #{memo}, ExecState = 'exec', ChangeId = #{execId}, ChangeName = #{execName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE MantncNo = #{mantncNo} AND ExecState <> 'cmplet'

UPDATE shopwizard.tOprMantnc SET ExecState = 'cmplet', CmpletCntnts = #{cntnts}, CmpletDate = NOW(), CmpletId = #{cmpletId}, CmpletName = #{cmpletName}, ChangeId = #{cmpletId}, ChangeName = #{cmpletName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE MantncNo = #{mantncNo} AND ExecState <> 'cmplet'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM shopwizard.tOprMantnc WHERE MantncNo = #{mantncNo} AND ExecState <> 'cmplet'
